english.note: This is the all-purpose casual choice when admitting that a fact, allegation, or mistake is true.

examples.english: I admit this was my own mistake.
examples.traditional: 呢單嘢我認係自己做錯。
examples.jyutping: ni1 daan1 je5 ngo5 jan6 hai6 zi6 gei2 zou6 co3

boxes.meaning: to recognize as, accept as (a relative etc.)

english.note: Use this when recognizing someone’s identity, status, relationship, or authority.

examples.english: I acknowledge him as my older brother.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jan6 keoi5 hai6 ngo5 aa3 go1
